messages.subject: A kronecker function for a ddmatrix (pbdDMAT)
messages.subject_clean: A kronecker function for a ddmatrix (pbdDMAT)
messages.body_plain:
Hi All,

Is it possible to get a kronecker function for ddmatrix objects.

This will be very useful for multivariate algorithms that will take advantage of the distributed matrices.

I do not know how this works for ddmatrices so I will appreciate if anybody has code or ideas.

Thanks.

Uche.
